definitions: A complex network of macromolecules secreted by cells that provides structural and biochemical support to the surrounding cells.

The non-cellular component present within all tissues and organs, providing essential physical scaffolding for cellular constituents and initiating crucial biochemical and biomeical cues that are required for tissue morphogenesis, differentiation, and homeostasis.
examples: The extracellular matrix plays a crucial role in tissue repair.
Components of the extracellular matrix include collagen and elastin.
Disruptions in the extracellular matrix can lead to various diseases.
